children: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $276.86M, a slight increase from $274.18M a year earlier, and a net loss narrowed to ($12.91M) versus ($18.27M) in the prior-year quarter; diluted loss per share improved to ($0.37) from ($0.54). 10-Q Summary.
¹ Reported as “Product sales and other”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”. ³ Reported as “Earnings per share - Basic and Diluted”.
Revenue growth was driven by expansion of the BNC First Day® program and continued migration to affordable access and digital content, boosting course material unit sales.
Partnerships, including an expanding relationship with Fanatics/Lids, are enhancing e-commerce, logo GM assortment and digital marketing capabilities.
Company operated 1,062 physical and virtual bookstores after opening 34 and closing 88 locations during the quarter.
Timing of First Day® collections shifted later in the cycle, increasing focus on aligning vendor outflows with school inflows and affecting cash and working capital timing.
